baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form of تَأَذَّنَ, the title رَبُّكُمْ, and the emphatic replies to both conditional clauses.
baseline_models.mechanism: The announcement is performative rather than merely predictive: the sovereign who owns, tends, and completes binds his own action to the hearers' response. Increase is therefore enacted governance, while the second clause presents punishment as an already established severe reality.

activation_trace.role: Self-obligation joined to notification gives the opening verb the force of a declared commitment.
Ownership and sovereignty identify the speaker as competent to establish and execute the rule.
Stepwise tending and completion make the promised addition a developmental act, not a detached payment.
Actual growth supplies the positive outcome that the commitment will cause.
Force, hardness, and fixed severity make the negative consequence more than a mild withholding.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports that gratitude will be rewarded and ingratitude punished.
changed_reading.after: The Lord publicly binds his governance to an asymmetrical rule: gratitude receives enacted growth, while ingratitude encounters a punitive severity already declared as real.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opposition of شَكَرْتُمْ and كَفَرْتُمْ around لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Gratitude can be read as productive responsiveness: a slight input becomes visible fullness, greening, or a fresh shoot. Increase amplifies that responsiveness. Ingratitude, by contrast, covers the gift or its effect, interrupting manifestation rather than merely failing to feel thankful.

activation_trace.role: Recognition and visible acknowledgment supply the ordinary receptive act.
A small amount producing an evident effect turns gratitude into high-yield responsiveness.
Fresh growth emerging from a plant gives the response a generative, outwardly visible form.
Added growth is the amplification produced by successful response.
Concealing a benefit supplies the exact negative interruption of visible acknowledgment.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude is an inward moral attitude followed by an external reward.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude is the capacity to receive a gift and make its effect visible; increase is the amplification of that productive capacity, while ingratitude occludes the gift-effect relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The material polarity between شَكَرْتُمْ and عَذَابِى لَشَدِيدٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: One gratitude branch depicts intake becoming fullness, whereas branches under punishment depict abstention, prevention, or weaning, and severity can depict binding. The two outcomes can therefore be carried as assimilation versus constrained access, with ordinary punitive pain remaining primary.

activation_trace.role: Fullness and abundant yield model successful intake becoming stored nourishment.
A body refraining from food and drink supplies an embodied failure of intake.
Prevention and forced abstention give punishment a constrictive functional edge.
Tight fastening supplies the mechanism that makes deprivation severe and difficult to escape.

changed_reading.before: The negative clause only says that punishment will hurt intensely.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the verse opposes nourishing assimilation to severe constraint: gratitude fills and yields, while punishment can withhold, bind, or prevent sustaining uptake.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus self-commitment becomes the central form of a repeated permission structure. Deliverance into light, authorized action, garden entry, and recurrent fruit all occur under the same permission-and-Lord pairing, so promised increase reads as governed enablement across distinct transitions.

activation_trace.role: The self-binding announcement establishes the governing commitment at the focus.
Authorization supplies the enabling condition for the movement from darkness into light.
The tending Lord assigns that authorized movement a developmental direction.
Permission limits messenger agency and locates effective action in divine authorization.
Authorization governs entry into the enduring garden state.
Lordship identifies the authority under which that transition is secured.
Permission governs the tree's repeated production, making fruition enabled rather than automatic.
Tending and completion make recurring fruit an instance of the Lord's sustained cultivation.

structural_cues: The same permission root paired with Lordship appears at the surah opening, in the messenger exchange, at garden entry, and in the tree's recurring fruit.
The focus uniquely shifts that recurring permission vocabulary into a self-binding verbal announcement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated permission-Lord pairing and the focus form of self-obligation; I infer one governance axis linking these transitions. A live alternative is that each permission phrase is local and does not specify the mode of increase in 14:7.

changed_reading.before: The promise is a single isolated declaration of reward.
changed_reading.after: The promise is the explicit commitment behind a surah-wide permission system in which release, effective agency, secure entry, and recurrent fruition are enabled and tended.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate lead-in reconstructs gratitude as disciplined memory under trial. Reminder, benefit, rescue, and an ordeal that reveals condition precede the focus, so gratitude is not courtesy after comfort but a practiced refusal to let deliverance disappear from active awareness.

activation_trace.role: Recognizing and displaying a benefit supplies the focus response that memory must sustain.
An active reminder functions as the means by which past divine days remain present to response.
A good condition or benefit supplies the remembered object of gratitude.
Rescue by separation gives the benefit the concrete form of release from an oppressive condition.
A test that makes condition visible turns gratitude into a disclosed response rather than an untested sentiment.

structural_cues: 14:5 joins remembrance of divine days to signs for the steadfastly grateful.
14:6 immediately narrates rescue, preserved lives, affliction, and a great trial before 14:7 states the conditional.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the reminder-rescue-trial sequence; I infer that remembered deliverance is an input to the gratitude condition and that increase continues a released life. The alternative is that the history only motivates gratitude without defining its operation.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude is acknowledgment of a presently enjoyed benefit.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude is active memory that keeps rescue legible through trial; increase extends the life and capacity opened by deliverance rather than merely adding a new prize.

context_deltas.mechanism: The announcement-hearing potential in the focus is activated by a sequence of delivered signs, rejection, obstructed mouths, doubt, invitation, and authorization. Gratitude becomes successful uptake that converts a communicated gift into effect; kufr becomes a covered or blocked reception channel.

activation_trace.role: Notification by a call supplies the outgoing signal to which the two focus responses answer.
A small input producing visible effect supplies the successful reception-and-response side of the circuit.
Covering supplies the blockage that prevents a received sign or benefit from becoming manifest response.
Refusal of acceptance supplies the explicit rejection stage after clear communications arrive.
The mouth as an opening for speech becomes materially obstructed in the rejection scene.
Interpenetrating alternatives without settled certainty destabilize reception after the message is delivered.
A vocal summons supplies the directed invitation that the hearers contest.
Authorization distinguishes the effective source of the communicated sign from messenger control.

structural_cues: 14:9 moves from arriving reports and clear communications to bodily rejection, declared kufr, doubt, and a disputed call.
14:10-11 answer the doubt while denying autonomous messenger control over signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies communication, rejection, mouth, doubt, call, and permission; I supply the channel-and-uptake mechanism. The hand-to-mouth construction remains referentially open, and the scene can be read as rejection without treating it as a literal blocked channel.

changed_reading.before: The two conditions name private attitudes toward benefits.
changed_reading.after: The conditions also diagnose reception: gratitude lets an announced gift produce a response and further effect, whereas kufr covers or rejects the channel through which the gift becomes intelligible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The punishment scene materializes the focus-only intake polarity. Liquid is administered and is recognizably water, yet it cannot pass smoothly as drink. Severe punishment becomes anti-assimilation: supply reaches the sufferer but cannot become sustaining uptake.

activation_trace.role: Fullness and abundant yield supply the positive pole of nourishment successfully taken in.
Refusal or inability to eat and drink supplies the embodied negative pole.
Prevention and weaning turn the negative pole into constrained access rather than mere scarcity.
Giving drink supplies an apparent act of provision inside the punitive scene.
Water supplies the ordinarily sustaining material whose function is then frustrated.
Failure of smooth passage through the throat specifies the blocked-assimilation mechanism.

structural_cues: 14:16-17 gives a tightly sequenced drinking scene: administered liquid, attempted gulping, failure to swallow, approaching death, and continuing punishment.
This material sequence is the inverse of the focus gratitude branch in which intake readily becomes fullness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the failed drinking sequence and the focus branch polarity; I infer that it exemplifies punishment as anti-assimilation. A live alternative is that the scene only depicts one punishment and does not define the semantic range of the focus noun.

changed_reading.before: Severity means a greater quantity of pain.
changed_reading.after: Severity can also mean provision rendered unusable: what reaches the mouth cannot become nourishment, the material inverse of gratitude's capacity to turn slight input into fullness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus severity word is reused for wind acting on the works of those who cover. Earned output becomes ash, violent air disperses it, and its owners lose effective control. Increase is thereby revised from gross addition to durable, retainable efficacy; the negative pole is not only less gain but the loss of hold over produced effects.

activation_trace.role: Covering a benefit supplies the response whose produced works later fail to remain available.
Growth supplies the positive quantity that context now qualifies by durability and control.
Intensified force transfers the focus severity vocabulary into the dispersing agent.
Burnt residue supplies an output that exists materially but has lost coherent productive form.
Moving air carries the residue away from its putative owners.
A force that lifts and scatters light material supplies the causal dispersal mechanism.
Practical ability and possession are explicitly negated, showing that accumulated output is no longer effective.
Acquired gain supplies the object whose availability collapses despite prior effort.

structural_cues: 14:18 places kufr, works, ash, intensified wind, earnings, and inability inside one simile.
The same root that qualifies punishment in 14:7 qualifies the wind that removes control over acquired output.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies produced works, residue, dispersal, and lost ability; I infer that durable retention is one dimension of promised increase. The alternative is that the simile only nullifies works and does not redefine increase.

changed_reading.before: Increase means having a larger amount, and punishment is a separate painful event.
changed_reading.after: Increase includes durable efficacy and retained access to what bears fruit; the severe negative is dispersal that leaves prior acquisition present only as uncontrollable residue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus growth model becomes a temporal ecology. A stable tree repeatedly yields usable fruit, while the bad tree is removed from its root and cannot settle. Later, fruit provision in a non-cultivated valley is directed toward gratitude, reversing the focus arrow and closing a possible loop: provision elicits gratitude, and gratitude conditions further increase.

activation_trace.role: Fresh shoots supply the focus-side image of response becoming new growth.
Growth supplies the feedback output whose recurrence the context makes visible.
Seed-covering introduces an agricultural branch whose productivity depends on whether stable growth actually emerges.
A trunked plant supplies the organism that converts rooted stability into ascending and recurring output.
Continuing stability supplies the condition under which production can recur rather than disperse.
Plant yield supplies a usable output repeatedly delivered from the stable organism.
Removal of the whole plant from its root supplies the inverse mechanism: severed origin prevents continued yield.
The negated capacity to settle marks the bad system as unable to retain a productive state.
The explicitly absent cultivated growth makes later fruit provision non-default and therefore causally salient.
Allocated provision supplies the upstream gift directed toward a grateful response.
Fruit as realized benefit supplies the concrete output offered in the otherwise uncultivated setting.
Acknowledgment appears as the intended downstream response to fruit provision, reversing the focus conditional direction.

structural_cues: 14:24-26 contrasts fixed, recurrent fruiting with complete uprooting and absence of settlement.
14:37 moves from a valley lacking cultivation to allocated fruits with an explicit purpose of gratitude.
The focus gives gratitude followed by increase, whereas 14:37 gives provision followed by hoped-for gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both causal directions; I infer a recursive feedback system and align the good and uprooted plants with the focus polarity. A live alternative is that the tree parable and the valley prayer are independent illustrations rather than a single feedback mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A completed act of thanks earns a later increment.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude and increase can form a recurring fruiting system: provision generates acknowledgment, acknowledgment sustains further growth, and stable rootedness lets the benefit return as usable fruit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Kufr is made into an active transformation rather than a zero response. A benefit is exchanged into kufr, and that conversion relocates a people into a condition of ruin. The focus negative condition can therefore describe destructive handling of a gift that also propagates socially.

activation_trace.role: Concealment of benefit supplies the focus act that context renders as transformation.
Visible recognition supplies the unconverted alternative to covering the benefit.
One thing taking the place of another supplies the explicit conversion operation.
Benefit and good condition supply the input that is destructively exchanged.
Causing settlement supplies the social transport from leaders' conversion to their people's destination.
Ruin and corruption supply the terminal state produced by the exchange.

structural_cues: 14:28 places benefit, kufr, substitution, a people, and an abode of ruin in one causal sentence.
The plural address of 14:7 remains compatible with consequences that pass through communal leadership and settlement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies benefit-to-kufr exchange and communal relocation; I infer that this concretizes the operation of the focus condition. The live alternative is that 14:28 targets a particular historical group and should not define every instance of kufr in 14:7.

changed_reading.before: Ingratitude is passive failure to acknowledge a benefit.
changed_reading.after: Ingratitude can actively convert a benefit into a covering system whose effects propagate beyond the first responder and settle others in loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split focus inventory allows increase to shade into provision carried for movement. Context then presents commanded outflow from provision, descending water, emerging fruit, running transport and rivers, persistent celestial service, and benefits beyond enumeration. Increase can thus be expanded throughput and capacity within a circulating provision system, not private stockpiling.

activation_trace.role: Provision carried for transition gives increase the exploratory sense of added capacity to continue and move.
High-yield response supplies the human conversion point inside the wider provision flow.
Wealth leaving its holder supplies the required outflow rather than hoarding.
Allocated provision supplies the stock from which the commanded outflow occurs.
Delivery downward supplies the first transfer in the material production chain.
Water conveyed by pouring and irrigation supplies the mobile medium of production.
Fruit as realized benefit supplies the transformed output of descending water.
Continuous movement supplies the transport character of the provision system.
Persistent operation supplies temporal continuity rather than a one-time transfer.
Failed exhaustive enumeration marks the provision network as exceeding a closed inventory.

structural_cues: 14:31 commands spending specifically from what has been provided.
14:32 links descending water, produced fruit, provision, moving vessels, and rivers; 14:33 adds persistent cycles.
14:34 closes the sequence by denying human ability to enumerate the benefits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transfers, material conversion, movement, persistence, and uncountability; I infer a circulating system in which outflow can participate in increase. The alternative is that these are parallel gifts and that 14:7 promises an individual addition without a circulation claim.

changed_reading.before: Increase is a larger private balance held by the grateful person.
changed_reading.after: Increase may be greater provisioned capacity and throughput: gifts descend, transform, move, and are spent onward while the sustaining system continues beyond any recipient's inventory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus self-commitment answers an accounting asymmetry. Humans cannot enumerate the incoming benefits, yet the final account stands, no act is outside awareness, the promise is not missed, and each self receives a matching consequence quickly. Gratitude is therefore truthful acknowledgment without exhaustive counting; kufr is not made plausible by the gifts' uncountability.

activation_trace.role: Self-obligation supplies the guarantee that the two conditional outcomes will not be omitted.
Acknowledgment supplies a truthful response that does not require exhaustive enumeration.
Concealing benefit supplies the failed human-side accounting response.
Counting supplies the attempted inventory of benefits.
Exhaustive enumeration is explicitly negated, defining the limit of recipient-side accounting.
The standing account supplies the contrasting complete reckoning of response and action.
Negated inattentiveness excludes omission from the divine side of the mechanism.
Negation of an unmet promise excludes failure at the execution stage.
A statement opening expectation supplies the commitment whose fulfillment is secured.
Matching an act with its consequence supplies the settlement operation.
Absence of delay qualifies the execution of the final account.
The closing account completes the arc from uncountable inputs to fully matched outcomes.

structural_cues: 14:34 says benefits cannot be exhaustively counted; 14:41 names the day when the account stands.
14:42 denies inattention, 14:47 denies promise failure, and 14:51 joins matching recompense to rapid accounting.
The focus begins with the Lord's emphatic self-commitment, fitting the no-omission sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed human enumeration, complete accounting, no inattention, promise fulfillment, and matching recompense; I organize them as an asymmetric ledger. The ledger metaphor is reader-supplied, and the passages can remain separate claims about benefit, knowledge, promise, and judgment.

changed_reading.before: The conditional resembles a simple exchange in which a countable act earns a countable return.
changed_reading.after: The rule bridges unequal accounting capacities: recipients need not enumerate every gift to acknowledge it, while the Lord's committed response loses no act, promise, or consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ر ب و mapping under رَبُّكُمْ and risks sounding like an etymological claim. It remains packet-anchored because that split inventory explicitly supplies increase, elevation, nourishment, and growth beside the focus increase verb. Downstream prose should present it only as a lexical resonance, never as replacement of the dominant Lordship reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacency of رَبُّكُمْ and لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ, with growth branches available under both mapped inventories.

activation_trace.role: Increase and elevation make the speaker-title itself echo the action promised later in the clause.
Feeding and organic development give the echoed increase a cultivational direction.
Explicit added growth provides the primary action with which the title's distant branch resonates.
Emergent shoots give the double-growth resonance a visible organic rendering.

changed_reading.before: The Lord is the actor, and increase is an unrelated action attributed to him.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical resonance, the actor-title carries a distant growth potential that echoes the explicit promise: the one who tends and raises will cause responsive growth to grow further.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the later punishment as a material reversal of the focus roots, although the packet never labels the relation retaliatory. It remains validly anchored in the focus branches of covering and tight binding and in the later bonds, clothing, pitch, and overlying fire. Downstream prose should call it an exploratory structural echo, not a definitive explanation of punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The covering branch of كَفَرْتُمْ and the fastening branch of شَدِيدٌ.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the action-form that later returns as an imposed external covering.
Tight fastening supplies a concrete material rendering of severity.
Bonds and fetters realize severity as imposed fastening.
Garments supply the first enclosing layer around the punished body.
Adhesive flowing pitch specifies the material of the enclosing layer.
An overlying cover supplies the rebound in which covering is no longer chosen but suffered.

changed_reading.before: Kufr and severe punishment are morally linked but materially unrelated.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the consequence mirrors the act's structure: chosen covering is answered by imposed covering, and declared severity becomes literal fastening and enclosure.

strongest_changes: The self-binding announcement became the explicit center of a repeated permission-and-Lord axis governing release, agency, entry, and fruition.
Gratitude and increase became a recursive productive system: stable reception yields fruit, provision elicits gratitude, and gratitude conditions further growth.
Kufr became active interruption and conversion, producing blocked intake, dispersed acquisition, social relocation, and loss of durable effect.
The promise became an answer to asymmetric accounting: benefits exceed human enumeration, while divine awareness, fulfillment, and recompense omit nothing.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly turned the focus's abstract polarity into mechanisms of permission, memory, reception, nourishment, plant stability, circulation, conversion, and accounting. Most distinctive was the reversed arrow at 14:37, where fruit provision is aimed at gratitude and can close the focus conditional into a feedback loop.
remaining_uncertainties: The reception-circuit reading depends partly on an ambiguous hand-to-mouth construction.
The tree, valley, and circulation sequences may illuminate 14:7 without constituting one unified causal system.
The non-dominant ر ب و and ز و د mappings are useful exploratory resonances but must not displace the dominant forms.
The packet supports assured outcomes but does not settle their timing or whether every increase is materially visible.
